# iMessage MCP

> iMessage MCP is a free, open-source macOS app and MCP server that lets AI tools read, search and send Messages (iMessage/SMS) without Full Disk Access. The app is sandboxed, has no network entitlement, and the owner approves every connection and every sent message.

Key facts:
- Does not require Full Disk Access: the owner picks ~/Library/Messages once; the app keeps a read-only, app-scoped bookmark. Verified on macOS 27.0.1 with real messages.
- Runs a local Unix-socket bridge with owner-set limits (duration, message slots, requests per minute). Every connection needs owner approval.
- send_message shows the exact recipient and text and sends only after the owner confirms. Delivery is not confirmed by the app.
- Requires macOS 13 or later. License: MIT.
